_comment: Firestore composite indexes for the Tiger Foods agentic AI. Apply with: gcloud firestore indexes composite create --collection-group=steps --query-scope=COLLECTION --field-config field-path=session_id,order=ASCENDING --field-config field-path=step_index,order=ASCENDING. Most queries are covered by Firestore's automatic single-field indexes; the explicit indexes below are only needed if the UI does collection-group queries across sessions.
